name: Laszlo Kovacs
bio:
Laszlo Kovacs's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for Formula 1, fueled by late-night races broadcast from Europe. Despite a lack of family connections to the sport, Laszlo's exceptional aptitude for mathematics and engineering steered him toward a career in motorsport. He graduated at the top of his class from Budapest University of Technology and Economics, specializing in vehicle engineering.

Before joining Team Penske, Laszlo spent several years honing his skills in various racing series, including GT and Formula 3. He is known for his meticulous approach to race strategy and his ability to identify and exploit even the smallest competitive advantages. He approaches his role as Sporting Director with a data-driven mindset, always seeking innovative solutions to optimize performance. Laszlo is highly regarded as an extremely effective leader, able to motivate his team to consistently perform at their best. 

His relentless pursuit of performance and his forward-thinking approach make him a valuable asset to any team. Although his management style may sometimes seem too direct, his underlying goal is always to win.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Laszlo is of average height with a lean build and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with racing data and calculations.
Has a habit of drumming his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking black coffee before every race, regardless of the time.
